set.body: Found by sweeping the AC4-S1 review BLOCK (Fray #100) through the author's own code. SampledFrameSet now binds streamIndex into its receipt parameters and identity. FrameSet (frames.scala) still does not: its receipt parameters are tool, geometry and caller-supplied args, and its identity is receipt, bytes digest and count. For a probe with two Decoded picture streams of equal geometry and packet count, two decodes with the same declared bytes digest and args share an identity while ptsOf differs. Not fixed in S1, because the lead's boundary keeps full FrameSet semantics intact and changing its identity changes every FrameSet receipt. Fix: bind streamIndex into FrameSet.parameters and identity, bump the algorithm tag, and test on a two-picture-stream probe (the S1 consumer suite shows how to derive one from F0).
set.title: [media] FrameSet identity and receipt do not bind streamIndex (pre-existing; same shape as the AC4-S1 review BLOCK)
